copy.curiosityHook: What begins as an enticing studio contract soon spirals into an inescapable nightmare within the stifling confines of an eerie hotel room.
copy.description: Lured to 1940s California to write for the movies, a celebrated New York playwright checks into a strange hotel and encounters the grim, disorienting realities of the Hollywood studio system.
copy.vibeSummary: Darkly funny, suspenseful, and heavy, balancing steady dramatic pacing with an increasingly surreal, high-friction atmosphere.
copy.whyWatch: Directed by Joel and Ethan Coen, this sharp blend of comedy, drama, and neo-noir thriller turns creative frustration into an unsettling, razor-sharp look at commercial filmmaking.

allowedMaterial: Playwright Barton Fink moving from New York to 1940s Hollywood
Writing for the movie business in an unsettling hotel setting

Blend of comedy, drama, thriller, and neo-noir tone
